progression.narrative: The performance opens on G5 and dwells most on Fk in Nowruz-e Arab. The line peaks at G4 (374.5 Hz) at 0:13.2. It closes on C4, not the tonic (Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → Fk4 → C4 → C4).
